g.text: Selection: enumerate all pairs within 0.5 percentage points in aging, then choose the largest and smallest industry gaps.
All eligible pairs are retained in the results table. These examples illustrate heterogeneity; they do not isolate a causal effect.
Population and industry sources and US calendar-year / Japan fiscal-year definitions are the same as Figure 1.
